Privacy

The Coordinates application has no analytics, advertising trackers, application accounts, cookies or persistent browser storage. Coordinate conversion, globe interaction and timezone lookup run locally in your browser. Pasted coordinates are not sent to an API or added to the page URL.

“My location” asks your browser for device location only when you click it. Your browser may use its own location services to obtain that position. Coordinates uses the returned position locally and does not send it to the application host.

Copy uses the clipboard only when you press Copy. External links open other sites with their own privacy policies. All fonts, maps and scripts required by this tool are served locally; no remote map or timezone API is called.

The hosting provider, reverse proxy or CDN may process access logs and use its own security or authentication mechanisms. This notice describes the Coordinates application, not independent hosting-provider behavior.
